name: Jump for Animals!
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Jump for Animals! 🐾

How to Play:
💪 Train your legs to increase your Jump Power
⬆️ Jump higher to reach new areas
🥚 Steal eggs guarded by giant animals
🏃 Escape and bring the eggs back to your plot
🐣 Hatch eggs to discover rare animals
💰 Earn money from your animals—even while offline
🏋️ Upgrade your barbells, trails, and speed coils
✨ Discover rare sizes, Mythic eggs, and secret animals
📖 Complete your Animal Index and claim rewards  

How high can you jump, and can you collect them all?

👍 Like the game and join the group for rewards and future updates!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players.
